finalText:
**Build's clean now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump's new options shape:

- [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right key.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so I added that case, treated as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise from the bump, harmless. `build finished ... 8 warnings, 0 errors`.
